annotations.title: Set up a new app, step by step

description: Start here for a new app, or when the stores or Ploa aren't set up yet; for an update it says what a store turned down that the person reads and answers. Works out where this folder stands (signed in, app IDs in the Expo config or, for a Flutter, React Native, Capacitor, Gradle or Xcode app, in its own projects, linked to Ploa, each store connected, the app created in each store, signing, store page, first build, Google Play's way to production) and returns what's next, in order: who does each step (the person or you), exactly what to do, and direct links that open the exact page in App Store Connect, Play Console, Apple's developer site and Ploa wherever Ploa knows the IDs. Until the person has chosen how you work (an autonomous agent, or approvals), it opens with that question for you to ask them; ploa_access records the answer. When the app has no bundle ID or package name yet, suggests a few to choose from and explains how the stores treat them. Read-only; run it again after each step.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
